name: Person Name
definition: Name by which a person is known and that is usually used to identify that person.

BirthName.name: Birth Name
BirthName.definition: Name received at birth, eg, maiden name.

NamePrefix.name: Name Prefix
NamePrefix.definition: Specifies the terms used to formally address a person.

NameSuffix.name: Name Suffix
NameSuffix.definition: Additional information about a person that follows a person's name, eg, qualification such as Doctor of Philosophy (PhD).

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Person identification which contains a name.
